label: Frontend QA candidate; production release blocked

blockers.summary: The /ro/... URL strategy is approved, but complete Romanian UI, content, metadata and alt text are not approved or implemented.
Official Moldova branch phones are published, but the local legal entity, written consultation recipient, server transport, consent text and retention rules are not approved.
The claims registry has no Moldova legal approvals; product classification, evidence and supplement warnings remain unconfirmed.
The source dataset contains 10 products, but only 7 are complete and publishable; the final assortment and disposition of 3 drafts are not approved.
Production usage rights for product, brand and editorial media require business confirmation.
Moldova-applicable certificates with issuer, product and validity metadata plus Moldova-specific FAQ, branches, Blog and News scope require approval.
The popularity sort uses official catalogue order because no approved popularity rank exists.
Push the workflow and require the quality-gates check in the GitHub main-branch ruleset.
Approve the production site origin, build with SITE_URL, deploy the prerendered routes and complete live Google Rich Results and URL Inspection validation.
